movies.title: Swapped
movies.description: A tiny woodland creature and a majestic bird suddenly swap bodies, forcing them to team up to survive the wildest adventure of their lives.

movies.title: The Ice Age Adventures of Buck Wild
movies.description: The fearless one-eyed weasel Buck teams up with mischievous possum brothers Crash & Eddie as they head off on a new adventure into Buck’s home: The Dinosaur World.

movies.title: Jurassic World 2015
movies.description: The film revolves around the story of a deceased doctor’s discovery that changed humanity about recovering DNA from giant reptiles survived millions of years. Dinosaurs in turn are revived through DNA of the fossilized mosquitoes’ blood . Gradually they develop into a conservation park and want to turn it into a world park.

movies.title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom
movies.description: Three years after the destruction of the Jurassic World theme park, Owen Grady and Claire Dearing return to the island of Isla Nublar to save the remaining dinosaurs from a volcano that’s about to erupt. They soon encounter terrifying new breeds of gigantic dinos while uncovering a conspiracy that threatens the entire planet.

movies.title: Jurassic World Rebirth
movies.description: The film revolves around a skilled covert operations team embarking on a high-stakes mission to secure genetic material from the world’s largest remaining dinosaurs. Five years after the events of Dominion, the planet’s ecology has become inhospitable to these prehistoric creatures, leaving them isolated in tropical environments. The team’s quest for a life-saving breakthrough uncovers a shocking conspiracy that has been hidden from the world for decades.

movies.title: Jurassic World: DominionFour years after the destruction of Isla Nublar, dinosaurs now live and hunt alongside humans all over the world. This fragile balance will reshape the future and determine, once and for all, whether human beings are to remain the apex predators on a planet they now share with history's most fearsome creatures in a new era of coexistence.  Genre: Action, Adventure, Sci-FiActor: Chris Pratt, Bryce Dallas Howard, Laura DernDirector: Colin TrevorrowCountry: United StatesDuration: 147 minQuality: HDRelease: 2022IMDb: 5.6

They fight to gain Allspark - things have the ability to bring the ultimate power to those who possess it. And then the Earth accidentally catch up in the fierce battle with the destructive weapons which two races can variously transform from the vehicles to the massive destruction machines …

movies.title: Transformers: The Last Knight
movies.description: Humans are at wars with the Transformers while Optimus Prime is absent. The only way to save the humanity is lying in the secrets of the past and the hidden history of Transformers on Earth and our heroes are the only hope to save the day.

movies.title: Transformers: Revenge Of The Fallen
movies.description: Content of Transformers: Revenge Of The Fallen: Deceptico returnes to Earth with a chasing target - Sam Witwicky, after he accidentally knew the secret of The Transfiguration and their ancient history. With a mission to protect humankind, leader Optimus Prime set up an international military alliance to be ready for the 2nd glorious fight

movies.title: Kraken
movies.description: Marine biologist Johanne is doing research on a fish farm in Vangsnes, a rural community located by the fjord, when she encounters several strange occurrences. Along with the brutal deaths of two local teenagers, all signs point to the deep fjord; can there be more to the depths than the eye can see? At the bottom of the deepest fjord rests a mythical monster as large as a mountain, with a myriad of arms ready to crush and devour anything they can grab.

movies.title: The Meg
movies.description: Jonas Taylor, a rescue diver, attempts to save a group of scientists, from a pre-historic 75-foot-long shark known as the Megalodon that is terrorizing a beach.

movies.title: Meg 2: The TrenchThe film follows a daring research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest reaches of the ocean. Their voyage spirals into chaos when a malevolent mining operation threatens their mission and forces them into a high-stakes battle for survival. Pitted against colossal Megs and relentless environmental plunderers, the heroes must outrun, outsmart, and outswim their merciless predators in a pulse-pounding race against time.  Genre: Action, Sci-Fi, HorrorActor: Jason Statham, Wu Jing, Shuya Sophia CaiDirector: Ben WheatleyCountry: United States, ChinaDuration: 116 minQuality: HDRelease: 2023IMDb: 5.0
Mercy

movies.title: Migration
movies.description: After a migrating duck family alights on their pond with thrilling tales of far-flung places, the Mallard family embarks on a family road trip, via New York City, to tropical Jamaica.

movies.title: Rampage (2018)
movies.description: As three different animals infected with a dangerous pathogen tear across North America, destroying everything in their path, a primatologist and a geneticist team up to stop them from destroying Chicago.

movies.title: Jurassic Park
movies.description: On a secret island, the dinosaur recreation work is completed by the rest DNA on the ancient mosquito. Before opening his park, Mr. Hammond invited a group of scientists come to visit and help him. But in a stormy night, the protection system collapses, the ancient giant beast escape…

movies.title: Firebreak
movies.description: Little Lide disappears in the forest while her family packs up their home. As a fire breaks out, her mother must race to reach her before the flames do.

movies.title: GOAT
movies.description: A small goat with big dreams gets a once-in-a-lifetime shot to join the pros and play roarball, a high-intensity, co-ed, full-contact sport dominated by the fastest, fiercest animals in the world.

movies.title: Crime 101
movies.description: When an elusive thief whose high-stakes heists unfold along the iconic 101 freeway in Los Angeles eyes the score of a lifetime, with hopes of this being his final job, his path collides with a disillusioned insurance broker who is facing her own crossroads. Determined to crack the case, a relentless detective closes in on the operation, raising the stakes even higher.

movies.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
movies.description: Dr. Kelson finds himself in a shocking new relationship - with consequences that could change the world as they know it - and Spike’s encounter with Jimmy Crystal becomes a nightmare he can’t escape.

movies.title: Scream 7
movies.description: When a new Ghostface killer emerges in the quiet town where Sidney Prescott has built a new life, her darkest fears are realized as her daughter becomes the next target. Determined to protect her family, Sidney must face the horrors of her past to put an end to the bloodshed once and for all.

movies.title: Predator: Badlands
movies.description: Cast out from his clan, a young Predator finds an unlikely ally in a damaged android and embarks on a treacherous journey in search of the ultimate adversary.

movies.title: Hoppers
movies.description: Scientists have discovered how to ‘hop’ human consciousness into lifelike robotic animals, allowing people to communicate with animals as animals. Animal lover Mabel seizes an opportunity to use the technology, uncovering mysteries within the animal world beyond anything she could have imagined.

movies.title: Project Hail Mary
movies.description: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction… but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.
